approval.statusNote: DRAFT. D-169 records these readings for review; it does not approve them. Only the owner may set APPROVED, by a separate decision; production refuses DRAFT. Any correction is a new targets version with a new pin and a new owner decision.

coordinates: master canvas, continuous: pixel i covers [i, i+1); x right, y down. eyeLeft / eyeRight = image left / image right, the same convention as browLeft / browRight in r3-face-parts/targets-v1.json

reference.readingMethod: visual reading on x6 crops with a 10 px grid; the eye silhouettes were measured by a flood fill of non-skin pixels. No automatic feature extraction for the points.

ringCentre.definition: Centre of the dark iris ring: the midpoint of its left/right and top/bottom extremes.
ringCentre.rationale: The ring's top runs under the upper lash line, so its top extreme is partly RECONSTRUCTED; left, right and bottom are visible.

outerCorner.definition: Lateral tip of the eye outline: the eye silhouette's extreme x on the side away from the face midline.
outerCorner.rationale: x agrees with the measured silhouette [402, 277, 477, 355]; y is ill-defined in this style.

innerCorner.definition: Medial extreme of the eye outline, nearest the face midline.
innerCorner.rationale: Reported after placement, never fitted. y is ill-defined in this style.
